recommendations.evidence_level: Japanese-language source vocabulary and editorial conventions, not measured search habits or model-by-model provenance verification.

title_patterns.phone: {exact model}の壁紙{count}枚｜無料ダウンロード | PhWalls
title_patterns.desktop: {exact collection}の壁紙{count}枚｜デスクトップ背景 | PhWalls
title_patterns.mobile_os_variant: {OS/version/code name}のスマホ用壁紙{count}枚 | PhWalls
title_patterns.edition: {exact model + full edition}の壁紙{count}枚 | PhWalls

recommendations.description_pattern: Lead with exact model/edition and actual inventory count; add one or two verified collection features (dark/light counts, formats, colors/styles, specific dimensions), then the appropriate use and download action.
recommendations.native_style: Use Japanese sentence grammar around exact Latin product names. Do not translate Pixel, Xperia, Galaxy, Fold, Flip, Pro, Ultra, FE, Community Edition into vague Japanese identifiers. Avoid stuffing 壁紙, 待ち受け, 無料, 高画質 in every sentence.

conditional_claims.無料: Only if PhWalls download is actually free. This does not imply copyright-free or permitted commercial reuse.
conditional_claims.純正/公式/標準/デフォルト: Use only with per-collection or per-file provenance confirming the claim.
conditional_claims.4K/8K: Use only with file-level dimensions and intended aspect-ratio verification; do not derive from model display specification.
conditional_claims.ライブ壁紙: Prefer 動画壁紙/動画 for actual MP4 downloads; an MP4 is not necessarily a native live-wallpaper installation package.
conditional_claims.待ち受け: Optional phone secondary wording; no measured demand evidence supports prioritizing it, and it is unsuitable for PC/OS desktop collections.

classification_exceptions: Ubuntu ... Mobile Phone uses 2160×3840 phone images despite desktop category.
Chrome OS for Phone is a named phone variant despite desktop category.
Microsoft Surface Duo/Duo 2 are stored as desktop but should not automatically say PC wallpaper.
Android 15 sample contains 5120×2880 landscape images; do not universally label all Android OS images as vertical smartphone wallpapers.
Galaxy Z Flip cover assets can be identified where filenames explicitly include cover; do not assert all Fold/Flip files support both cover and inner displays.
Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold and some Samsung Wxx collections may have phone category; preserve exact model and avoid category-based hardware claims.
variant_integrity: Retain Pro, XL, Ultra, FE, Plus, 4G/5G, Fold/Flip and full named editions.
Google Pixel 6(October 8) and Google Pixel 3 Promotional must retain their collection distinctions.
Galaxy Note 10+ Star Wars and Star Wars Edition remain distinct collections (9 vs8 assets).
Windows 7, Windows 7 Downloadable and Windows 7 Regional are separate collections; do not silently merge.
Preserve Ubuntu version/codename and Mobile Phone suffix; collection names are evidence, not proof of release status.
